subject: Final steps: wire credentials + structured remit mapping for Starlite Media
messages:
From: Megan Lopez <megan.lopez@starlitemedia.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Starlite bank details + invoice label mapping

Hi Aditya / Ben —

Thanks for walking us through the onboarding checklist today. Per request, attaching our completed W9 and a filled bank details CSV (bank_details_template.csv). A couple of notes so funds and remits land cleanly on our side: 

- Please include the Purchase Order number (PO-8964) in the remittance note field on the ACH/wire so our AP team can auto-match. Example remittance field: "PO-8964 / INV-2028-3345".
- Our preferred invoice label is: STLR_Invoice_[PO]_[INV#] (e.g., STLR_Invoice_PO-8964_INV-2028-3345).
- We prefer wires to go to our USD account; micro-deposits for ACH verification are fine if you prefer.

Let us know the next steps on your side and any additional evidence your payments team needs. I copied finance@starlitemedia.com for records.

Thanks,
Megan Lopez
Director, Finance Operations
Starlite Media
attachments: Starlite_W9.pdf (pdf), bank_details_template.csv (csv)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Lopez <megan.lopez@starlitemedia.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-13T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Starlite bank details + invoice label mapping

Megan —

Appreciate you sending these over. Quick confirmation and the remaining items we'll action from our side: 

1) Bank/Wire routing: we'll ingest the CSV into our vendor portal and target a wire test on Thurs 6/14. If you want the ACH micro-deposit instead, say the word and we'll schedule that instead.

2) Remit mapping: we will require the PO number in the remittance note for automated reconciliation. Your example remittance field format works perfectly. We'll configure our payout engine to emit: "STLR_Invoice_PO-8964_INV-2028-3345" as the payment reference.

3) Evidence: we have your W9 attached to the vendor record. For final activation we also need a signed copy of the vendor onboarding form (I've attached a link to a DocuSign below).

4) Cutoff/lead times: once wire/ACH is verified, first live payment will go on our next weekly run (Tuesday payouts) unless you request a one-off.

Next steps for you: confirm whether you prefer wire or ACH micro-deposit for verification; confirm the exact remittance contact (name + email) for automated remittance receipts.

I'll create the portal entry and mark this ready for Ben/Priyom to run the verification.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
